title: Adjetivo predicativo largo: introducción
reviewer: Codex R33 local semantic source review

semanticReview.method: Inspección directa de fuente académica/institucional y pasaje localizado; artículo acotado; APA 7, Evidence y assessEntry posterior ejecutados.
findings: Timberlake describes Russian adjectives in predicative position and notes that the long form can serve as a predicate, including in constructions with past/future быть; the entry is restricted to this syntactic fact and removes an unsupported example-based rule.
Localizador: §§ 5.2.5–5.2.6, p. 282, lines 10344–10363: qualitative adjectives can function as predicates; long-form adjective may occur predicatively, including with past/future быть.
APA 7: Timberlake, A. (2004). A Reference Grammar of Russian. Cambridge University Press. https://doi.org/10.1017/CBO9780511616373
limitations: Se eliminaron afirmaciones de frecuencia, registro o significado fuera del alcance verificado.
Se conservaron los enlaces de entradas relacionadas originales.
